notes.title: New Terrain Update!
notes.content:
Hello spaceship pilots!

We are excited to announce an exciting new major update to Galactic Lander!

Welcome to a new world of limitless possibilities, where you will have the challenging task of piloting your spaceship in brand new tunnels across the galaxy that are more smooth and less chunky.
We look forward to hearing your discoveries in these new levels!

Explore the newly shaped tunnels we have marked for you, or create your own in the level editor and publish them to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/913600/workshop/]Steam Workshop[/url]!

Pilot your spaceship alone, or with a friend in both local and over-the-net co-op!

We hope you will enjoy this update as much as we had making it!

Good luck, and as always, have fun!

notes.title: 'Small Improvements' Update
notes.content:
Greetings!

It's been a very long time since we got an update for Galactic Lander, but it's finally here!
This update brings one quality-of-life improvement and some other changes, let's take a look.

[h2]Smoother Co-op Loading[/h2]
Loading into a level with your buddy in co-op should feel a little more pleasant.
While waiting for all players to properly load into the level and get in sync, you can look at this minimalist screen and read a quick tip!

[h2]Missile Upgrades[/h2]
The new missile may look the same as the old one, but don't let that deceive you!

This update fixes an annoying bug where the missile touches/pushes the player, but does not explode.

And now, [b]missiles no longer fly through the level![/b]

[h2]Minor Networking Improvements[/h2]
Increased the network rate for sampling entites' states.

[h2]Some Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug with replay ghost entities appearing when they should be.
[*] Fixed a bug where a ship's landing gears were not properly breaking when a ship gets blown up.
[*] Fixed engine particles still playing after getting detached from the ship.
[*] Fixed UI ship health status not being updated correctly when the local player's ship explodes.
[/list]

That's it!


Also, I am very happy to read all new reviews for Galactic Lander as we are reaching [b]100 reviews![/b] Exciting stuff indeed.

Happy gaming!

Today's update brings improvements to the replay system, which now shows in more detail what happened the last time you played the level, meaning past missiles, crates and even other players if played in co-op mode.

Previously the replay only showed your own past ship, which wasn't a bug but simply a limited system. I expanded and improved the system based on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/913600/announcements/detail/1628524688281880597]RA2lover[/url]'s suggestion.

Enjoy the update, and have fun!

notes.title: 'Lander Remade' Mega-Update!
notes.content:
Hello, and welcome to the Lander Remade update!

[h1]What is it?[/h1]
For the past month or so I have been working hard to fix many bugs in Galactic Lander, as well as add long-awaited features and mechanics.

[h1]What's included?[/h1]
The most important newly-added features are all the new additions/changes to the level editor, the new game-wide event, and improvements and changes to both the death and victory prompts, and more.

To celebrate this mega-update, a game-wide special event has also been added which will run from the 5th of May to the 15th. The new event adds 10 exclusive new levels, and upon finishing the event, you get a custom new ship skin to keep forever!

[h1]Full patch-note list[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added game-wide event 'Lander Remade'
[*] Ships now explode either when struck with a missile, or when hitting something too hard
[*] Improvements to the victory prompt menu ('try to beat' times and other stuff)
[*] Improvements to the death/loose prompt menu
[*] Fixed bugs in level editor
[*] New file browser for selecting a custom level preview for when uploading levels to the Steam workshop
[*] Fixed controls-bug in local coop split-screen gameplay
[*] Player-crate rope mechanic (which is optional, and can be turned on or off through the developer console, more info about it [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/913600/announcements/detail/1628524688253963171]here[/url])
[*] New tutorial for the level editor
[*] New achievement which has to do with the new level editor tutorial
[*] Removed loading text that appears at start of level in the center of screen when playtesting a level.
[/list]

notes.title: [Testing Branch] Experimental Rope Feature
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33541654/44fa8a94956d50b6948e23e590a580707b083fe4.gif[/img]

Ropes... Ropes are cool...

[h1]Rope[/h1]
The idea for a rope to connect between the player's ship and a crate was an old idea that was never really implemented because I was working on other, more important features.

But for this upcoming mega-update, I worked on this feature and as of now it is available on the [testing] branch of Galactic Lander. To see this feature for yourself, simply fly to a crate as usual, and press X to pick up the crate. You should see a rope forming between your ship and the crate.

If you would like to continue playing Galactic Lander without this expiremental rope feature, simply open the game console by pressing the tilde '`' key and type 'rope_enable false' without the quotation marks.

[h1]I need your help![/h1]
When I playtested this feature myself, I wasn't sure whether or not it is actually a good idea. Therefore, in order to make the correct decision on whether to keep or scrap this new feature, I want to hear your feedback!

Players, if you happen to play on a level that has a crate in it, please give me feedback if you think the rope feature is a good idea, or is the old way better? (meaning the crate teleporting and sticking to the bottom of the ship)

Making your feedback is simple! There are a couple of options for you to give your feedback.

[list]
[*] You can submit your feedback on the [url=https://galacticlander.zerobyter.net/feedback]official Galactic Lander website[/url]
[*] You can [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/913600/discussions/1/]create a forum post[/url]
[*] Or you can simply leave a reply to this announcement!
[/list]

Thanks, and as always I am looking forward to hearing from you!

notes.title: [Testing Branch] New Features Being Tested!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33541654/371b04a0cd41ddc6c85e42bcf44e91d5696d273e.gif[/img]

Hello!

For this update, there are plenty of new features being added to the testing branch of Galactic Lander, lets go over them:

[h1]Ship Explosions![/h1]
Ships now explode! If you fly too recklessly and hit your ship into something too fast, it will erupt into two pieces and explode in a fiery of spaceship-gasses and other scientific stuff!

In addition, I have added a 3.5 seconds delay to the death prompt after the player has actually died so that the player could watch his ship for a bit after it has crashed.

Now when a player crashes his ship and looses, at least he can watch it go down hitting the level and maybe exploding before being prompted with the 'you died' menu.

Both the ship explosion and the death prompt delay will hopefully make the experience of loosing and having to restart a little more entertaining.

[h1]Victory Menu Adjustments[/h1]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1709440425][img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/972123867400354904/4FF0F3E0ECF9520F550EA7BF59FC91986F98F3E8/?imw=1024&imh=576&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=true[/img][/url]

The victory menu will now pull the best time and score result from the [url=https://www.zerobyter.net]zerobyter.net website[/url] API and display it as a challenge to the player to beat the best time and score completed for the specific level.

I have considered the possibility of players potentially cheating to set ridiculously fast times and scores for levels, and I have prepared a few counter-measures to combat that behavior if and when it will happen.


That's all for this update! Have fun!

notes.title: New Testing Branch
notes.content:
Hello!

I have opened a new testing branch, and over the coming weeks I plan to add new features and update the testing branch accordingly.

[h1]How to change branches?[/h1]
Changing branches back and fourth is very easy and straight-forward:
[list]
[*] In your Steam library, right click on Galactic Lander and click on "Properties"
[*] Click on the BETAS tab
[*] Change the drop down to "experimental"
[/list]

[h1]The first new improvement[/h1]
The first new feature I have added to the testing branch is a custom, in-game file browser for selecting a 'custom preview image' instead of the default one when uploading a level to the workshop.

At first I tried using the default Windows file selecting dialogue, but that didn't work out because of Unity's IL2CPP.

Then I added a workaround fix, which I finally got around to fixing in the new testing branch.

[h1]Feedback[/h1]
I want to emphasize that the testing branch isn't just for me to show off things before they go live on the default branch.

If you decide to play with the testing branch and encounter a bug or something that you think should change, I encourage you to take the initiave and provide your feedback [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/913600/discussions/1/]here on the Steam forums[/url].


I am looking forward to hearing back from you, the players about the new testing features which will eventually make it to the default branch!
- ZeroByter

notes.title: Future Plans For Galactic Lander.
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

For the past few months I have been unable/pre-occupied with other projects and things to work on Galactic Lander, but I came up with a few ideas for improving Galactic Lander.

[h1]GUI overhaul[/h1]
I will try experimenting with redesigning the GUI of the game to make it look more polished and interactable. If I can't come up with any designs which really draw my attention, than I will leave the current GUi as-is.

[h1]Ship explosions[/h1]
I also think it would be cool if, after the player's ship has sustained enough damage and once more hit a wall with enough force, the entire ship would explode in half and send debris everywhere.

I believe this would add more action and fun to the game, and perhaps make loosing your ship a little more entertaining.

[h1]More levels[/h1]
Of course, adding more official levels to the game for players to complete is always something pretty satisfying and fun to do.
It also gives more stuff for players to look forward to in the game.


I believe I will have something substantial to show in a week or two, perhaps more.

If you have any ideas or suggestions you think I haven't thought of, [i]as always[/i] I am happy and willing to listen to your thoughts, and maybe even your idea will make it to the game!

notes.title: Coop Game Start Fix
notes.content:
Hello!

[h1]The Fix[/h1]
Recently I have heard feedback and requests from players to fix a bug in coop mode where upon start of the game some ships would sometimes glitch out.

This was also mentioned in some reviews of Galactic Lander. Not every review specifically mentioned what kind of bug was encountered, but I believe the bug that was reported by a majority of players was the bug this update has just fixed.

Although there is still a slight graphical glitch which happens for an instant at the start, it shouldn't be very noticeable; if at all, and I don't expect it to ruin the player's overall experience of the game.

[h1]Random Spawn Positions[/h1]
Spawn positions are now random. Before this update, on each map the lobby owner would always spawn on one specific launch pad and the non-owner would spawn on the other remaining launch pad.

This has been changed, and now each play of a map will yield random spawn positions for all players.

[h1]Your Feedback Matters[/h1]
I feel it's important that Galactic Lander's player-base does not feel as if their voice is not being heard, or as if no improvements are being made for Galactic Lander (and for that matter, any game I release).

If a player complains about a bug or an issue with the game that I can reproduce and easily say "yes, this shouldn't be in the game" then I will deal with it, and I hope this update proves that.

Thank you for reading this announcement, for playing Galactic Lander, and for being awesome!
 - ZeroByter.

notes.title: You The Players & Controls Rebinding
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33541654/6b8e42256c365884d45ba505e08cfe2d64e4037d.png[/img]

It's been a while since I rolled out an update for Galactic Lander, but do not fear, I have not forgotten about Galactic Lander, and I am here to talk about a few things.

[h1]Control Rebinds[/h1]
This update's major change is replacing the 'invert controls' button with a much more flexible rebind system. You can now bind your ship's controls to anything, even your mouse buttons!

[h1]Achievements Bug[/h1]
While working on the update itself, I encountered a small, off-by-one bug which enabled achievements and stats while in the main menu, and this has been fixed.

[h1]The Amazing Playerbase, You Guys[/h1]
My first game on Steam, [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/800720/Space_Fighters/]Space Fighters[/url], wasn't an overwhelming success. No reviews, empty player base, and just another long-forgotten indie game.

Galactic Lander, however, is for me an all-around success. More than a month after it's release and I am proud of the fact people are still playing and enjoying Galactic Lander. Still today, each day sees around a total of 3-6 players playing Galactic Lander, which some people may say isn't a lot; but for me as an indie developer that is an outstanding achievement.

Galactic Lander also keeps on getting a steady stream of reviews, and that is also something I am very happy to see and read.

Not all reviews are good ones, and while I obviously would prefer people to enjoy my games; I remember that criticism is good, and I understand Galactic Lander and I aren't perfect.

So, thank you everyone, for giving my game a go, for reading this announcement, and for giving back feedback about my game, which I love to see and read.

Good luck, and happy gaming!
 - ZeroByter. ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Temporary Custom Workshop Previews Workaround
notes.content:
Hello!

Lately we have discovered a bug caused by Unity's IL2CPP which causes Galactic Lander to crash upon trying to select a custom workshop preview for a level in the level editor.

Unfortunately, while we still have not found a solution for this bug, I have come up with a temporary workaround for the issue.

Instead of opening a traditional 'choose file dialog', you must now manually input the full path (plus extension) of the custom preview image.

This isn't desirable, and this will be removed once a permanent fix is found, but until then this workaround will sadly have to stay around.


Thank you for your understanding and patience, and have fun!
 - ZeroByter

notes.title: New Levels And More
notes.content:
Hello!

Today I finally took the time to create a few more levels, simply because the game felt a bit too short and I wanted to add a harder challenge for those who make it their goal to fully complete the entire game.

I have added two more singleplayer levels, and six more co-op levels. Totaling at [b]twenty[/b] different singleplayer and co-op levels.

[h1]Why Not More?[/h1]
Creating levels for Galactic Lander is a unique challenge. It requires me to brainstorm and think about new ideas for levels which will be unique enough from other levels, difficult enough so as to not be too simple, and actually fun and enjoyable for the player to play and complete.

I hope this addition of levels will enrich your playing experience and will add more excellent content to the game!

[h1]Can't Have An Update Without Fixing Some Bugs[/h1]
No update is complete without a few bug fixes!
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where sometimes in coop, a landing pad randomly gets captured at the start of the level without the players doing anything, thus requiring only one player to complete the level.
[*] Fixed a minor UI bug in-game where sometimes, at a specific length of text, the vote-status text at the top of the screen would glitch out and look weird.
[/list]

[h1]User Feedback[/h1]
Game development, especially on the Steam platform has quickly become a strong passion of mine.

Every day, the first chance I get I go to check YouTube for any new gameplay videos of Galactic Lander and I check if there have been any new user-reviews for the game.

Finding new feedback/content from you guys, the community never fails to fill my heart with joy. Thank you!



That's all for today's update! Good game and have fun!

notes.title: Bugs Hotfix And Nearing Galactic Missions
notes.content:
Hi!

Today's update fixed two bugs, both involving co-op gameplay.

[h1]Missiles Synchronzation[/h1]
When I first started working on co-op for Galactic Lander, I made sure every action in the game was synchronized between clients, missiles also worked back then.

Apparently, something I changed since then has broken missiles again, and I have now fixed the issue.

[h1]Landing Pad Capturing Progress[/h1]
While playing the game, a friend of mine and I discovered that in no-gravity co-op mode, it's impossible to complete a level since you have to stick your ship upside onto the landing pad, but this for some reason did not work in co-op.

In co-op, every player ship except your own gets it's physics disabled, and therefore also it's collisions are disabled (how can you touch something without physics?), and so the landing pad wasn't registering the contact between it and the other player's ship.

I fixed this by correctly synchronizing when each landing pad started or stopped getting captured.

[h1]Galactic Missions[/h1]
The first galactic mission, although still a surprise secret, will start in the next few upcoming weeks! Follow us on [url=https://www.instagram.com/zerobyter_games/]Instagram[/url] to see when we will post a teaser of the galactic mission!


Thanks for reading, and as always, have fun!

notes.title: Fixin' Bugs And Level Customization
notes.content:
Thanks to [url]Oreli's[/url] curator group for their constructive-criticism and helpful review of Galactic Lander, I was able to patch a few bugs, as well as add some cool new features!

[h1]The crate-synchronization bug[/h1]
In co-op mode, when letting go of a crate there would sometimes be de-synchronization issues where one player sees his crate land at point A, but the other player due to lag, sees the crate land at point B. This would sometimes cause doors to not open to some players because their clients would not agree the crate has activated it's sensor.

This has been fixing by making it so when a player lets go of a crate in co-op, that same player also mentions where he dropped the crate and what is it's velocity. This makes the crate's landing point fully synchronized between clients.

[h1]Different-theme colored levels[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33541654/828c0d12078970b7740d87a9a27a217c3283bc52.jpg[/img]

Originally I had decided to make Galactic Lander level mostly colorless, the reasoning behind this was that the level would be in space, inside an asteroid, which aren't known for being very colorful.

Oreli suggested some levels could be colored differently, as if they were on Mars or Neptune, etc.

For this purpose I have created a new section in the level editor which allows any player to add their own unique touch to their levels by customizing the size of the 'background mist' and the general color theme of their levels.

[h1]Ship Strengthening[/h1]
The engineers over at 'Galactic Spaceship Manufacturer Co.' have finally figured out how to construct a stronger spaceship... The legs plus the engine boosters are now welded more strongly on to the ship. In other words, the legs and boosters won't break off the ship as easily.

[h1]Explosions![/h1]
Explosion sounds for missiles and other crashes have been replaced with more related, high-quality sound effects.


That is all, thanks for reading today's update announcement, and as always, have fun!

notes.title: Closed-Beta Giveaway Closed and More Updates
notes.content:
Lets jump right into today's announcement.

[h1]New Galactic Lander Group Chat[/h1]
Instead of creating a whole new Discord server for Galactic Lander (which sounds a bit like overkill), I opted for the much more light-weight approach of creating and setting up the Steam chat group for Galactic Lander. 

Now we can all have a place to discuss and talk about Galactic Lander live!

[url=https://s.team/chat/BIQul98c]Here is the group chat invite link[/url]

[h1]Closed-Beta Giveaway Failed Results[/h1]
Today marked the end of the three-day-long closed-beta giveaway for Galactic Lander, however due to an error in the giveaway-distribution code, a bug caused every person who registered for the giveaway to receive a key. Obviously, some people received a key that was already given to someone else before them, and therefore they were given an invalid key.

This is clearly unacceptable, and I deeply apologize for this critical error/mistake on my behalf. As compensation for this error, [b]everyone[/b] who registered for the Galactic Lander closed-beta giveaway that ended in the [b]26/9/2018[/b] will be given a free game key.

[strike]If the key you have received in your email is valid than that's good, but if you have not received an email or received an email with a key that was already taken, please post a thread about it on the Steam discussion forums, add me on Steam and message me personally about it, or leave a message about it on our group chat and you will be given a new, unused key.[/strike]

In order to properly compensate every person who registered for the closed-beta giveaway, I have sent out new emails which briefly explain the incident and also provided in the email is a new, unused, brand-new key for Galactic Lander.

Thank you for your understanding, and now on to the rest of announcement!

[h1]Bugs, Bugs, Bugs[/h1]
Even in outer space there are bugs; thankfully not the living ones. With the help of curator group [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/32852692-Oreli-Reviews-Some-Stuff/]Oreli Reviews Some Stuff[/url] and their willingness to report bugs on the discussion forums, I was able to find and eliminate a couple of game-breaking bugs I either wise would only hear about later.



That is all! Thank you for reading, and as always, I wish you all a good time playing fun games!

notes.title: Publicized Trello Roadmap And Game Progress
notes.content:
Hello!

Here at Galactic Lander Labs Co. I work very hard to get space ships to fly through cave-like structures in low gravity.

I wanted to update you on my progress, as well as to let you take a look for yourself!

Galactic Lander has come a long way since it's inception. It has become much more polished and enjoyable, especially with the addition of co-op gameplay (which wasn't even entirely planned in the beginning) the game is even more thrilling and fun, I had a blast just from testing the co-op gameplay with a couple of friends of mine!

I would outline all of the things I have left to finish for Galactic Lander, but since the [url=https://trello.com/b/pm3OYtL1/galactic-lander]Trello roadmap[/url] is now public, you can now take a full, detailed look for yourself!

That said, really the only major things I have to finish in order for Galactic Lander to become fully playable are:
[olist]
[*] A game-wide prompt system to alert the player of important notifications
[*] A proper settings menu to adjust graphics/controls
[*] Sound effects and possibly also a background music
[/olist]

[h1]Developer Streaming[/h1]
On a final note, for the past few days now I have been considering streaming myself coding/developing Galactic Lander right here on Steam. I was wondering if you think that is something you would be interested in watching? Please let me know in the comments of this announcement [b]or[/b] on my [url=https://twitter.com/RealZeroByter/status/1041054364880781317]Twitter post![/url]

Well, that is all for now! If you are interested in hearing more about Galactic Lander and it's development progress, I highly suggest following my on my [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/33112923]personal developer page[/url] and/or on my [url=https://twitter.com/RealZeroByter]twitter![/url]

Thanks for reading, and game on! :B1:
